extract_directory_from_url: extract the directory path from a URL using urlparse and os.path.dirname
expand_urls_with_weights: expand brace-notation URLs into a flat list with optional per-shard sampling weights
create_error_handler_log_and_continue: create an error handler that logs a warning for webdataset errors and returns True to continue processing
create_error_handler_dump_and_reraise: create an error handler that dumps the full traceback and re-raises the webdataset exception
get_error_handler_by_name: get a webdataset error handler function by name from the registered handlers dictionary
